messages.content: [system prompt omitted to save space — identical rendering rules as run2-t0.5, prompt revision before the Sunday-hours sentence]
Hello, you've reached Sakura Say-koh-tsoo-in. This is the clinic's AI receptionist, speaking in English. How can I help you today?
I strained my lower back and the pain is intense. Can you see me today?
If this is an emergency, please hang up and call 119 for an ambulance right away. If it's not an emergency, I can provide information about our hours and how to book. Would you like that?
No, it's not bad enough for an ambulance.

Thank you for clarifying. We are open today until seven in the evening. You can book an appointment through our online reservation form on our website, or I can have a staff member call you back to arrange it. What would you prefer?
Got it, thank you very much.
